title: 1dash.yaml v1+v2 — CI deploy spec (CI_EXTENSIBILITY_PLAN §3/§3b, CI_MULTI_SERVICE_PLAN §3)
description: Strict schema for 1dash.yaml. Parsed by the reusable workflow, sent as JSON in POST /api/ci/deploy. The server re-validates everything (workflow validation is UX only). oneOf enforces the per-version shape: v1 is the single-service manifest (unchanged), v2 adds the services map of independently deployed workloads with Dockerfile/context/type/App Trigger config. Unknown keys are rejected so typos fail fast in CI. Duplicate YAML keys cannot be detected by yaml.safe_load — the server rejects duplicate JSON keys at admission. Versioned by git ref in the workflow call.

version.description: Schema version: 1 = single-service manifest, 2 = multi-workload services map (shape enforced by oneOf).

name.description: Optional app identity. Default = sanitized repo name (lowercase DNS-label rules mirroring apps.ValidateInternalHostname). A push matching by provisioned_repo renames the row in place when name: differs.

domains.description: Optional explicit domains. Default = auto <name>.<autoDomainSuffix>. Each entry x ports[0] becomes a DomainBinding (publicPath and internalPath '/', tlsMode auto). Suffix must match AllowedDomainSuffix or equal the auto form (409 ERR_HOST_CLAIMED on conflict).

ports.description: Optional container ports. First = proxy target + health default. Empty (absent) means port 80. Ports beyond the first are accepted but only the first is routed (multi-port routing is out of scope).

replicas.description: Optional replica count. Default = policy.defaultReplicas. Yaml is source of truth: every CI deploy overwrites replicas (a manual scale-up IS reverted on next push). Negative is a 400, not fillDefaults.

resources.description: Optional resource limits (apps.ValidateResources). Zero = unlimited sentinel; memoryMb > 0 and < 4 is rejected (Docker minimum).

readiness.description: Optional readiness probe. path present = HTTP probe ({mode:http, httpPath:path}); absent = TCP default (existing behavior).

env.description: Optional plaintext non-secrets ONLY (map[string]string). Do NOT put secrets in git — attach secrets via dashboard env groups. Sorted by key for determinism when mapped to []EnvVar (secret:false).

envGroups.description: Optional subscribed env-group names. Must already exist (else ERR_UNKNOWN_ENV_GROUP). Resolved live at spawn time; app vars win on collision.

group.description: Existing env-group name (else ERR_UNKNOWN_ENV_GROUP). Existence resolves at materialize time — fail closed per spawn, never an empty dir.

path.description: Absolute clean container path. '/' and '..' segments rejected; must not overlap sibling mounts or volumes targets.

mode.description: Optional file mode, default 0640 (0600 breaks common non-root runtimes). Whitelist only.

envMounts.description: Optional file-mount groups (§3b). Materialized to <dataDir>/envmounts/<appID>/<groupID>/<KEY> and bind-mounted <hostDir>:<containerPath>:ro.

name.description: Optional App identity. Default = <sanitized-repo>-<service>. Overlong/reserved/conflicting names are rejected, never truncated.

type.description: REQUIRED in v2 (no implicit default). service = long-lived replicas; job = image with zero permanent replicas. Static artifacts stay outside.

context.description: Repo-root-relative build context dir (default .). Absolute paths, traversal, remote contexts, and CLI flags are rejected; must exist.

dockerfile.description: Repo-root-relative Dockerfile path (default Dockerfile). May sit outside the context but never outside the repo; must exist.

replicas.description: Service: default = policy.defaultReplicas. Job: must be 0 when present (zero replicas representation); positive replicas rejected.

ports.description: Service: first = proxy target. Job: must not be declared.

domains.description: Service: omitted = auto-domain policy, explicit [] = private. Job: must not declare entries.

readiness.description: Service: path present = HTTP probe. Job: must not declare a path.

deploy.description: Same shapes as v1. Cross-field job restrictions (no ports/domains/readiness, zero replicas) are enforced server-side.

schedule.description: Five-field cron or supported descriptor, optionally CRON_TZ=<zone> prefixed. Missing timezone normalizes to CRON_TZ=UTC server-side; empty = manual/authenticated-HTTP fire only.

command.description: Argv overriding the image CMD per fire; empty uses image ENTRYPOINT/CMD.

enabled.description: Default true; gates scheduled firing only.

triggers.description: Declarative App Triggers keyed by trigger name (existing trigger-name rules, scoped to the owning App). Missing/empty = desired CI-owned set is empty.

services.description: Independently deployed workloads keyed by canonical lowercase DNS-label service key.
